summary: TransAlta Corporation filed a Form 6-K reporting the voting results of its Annual and Special Meeting of Shareholders held April 30, 2026. The filing discloses that 63.55% of outstanding shares were represented; all nine director nominees were elected with 92-99% support; Ernst & Young LLP was reappointed as auditor; the advisory vote on executive compensation was approved at 96.69%; and a share unit plan amendment was approved at 98.53%. This is a routine post-meeting disclosure with no special-situation catalyst. This is a routine meeting results report, not a special situation.
